summary: Firstock drops the socket: the feed connects again on the same address, subscribes again (again before the login answer, audit FB-01), and the full tick after the login answer streams to the client as before.

notes: The desktop starts each connection without the previous snapshots (brokers/firstock/streaming.rs on_connected); the web keeps them (audit appendix item 11). Firstock's tick after the new subscribe is a full one, so the frames agree; a partial first tick would show the desktop's zeros for fields not yet sent.

deviations.reason: data.mode is the label every broker's frames carry on the desktop (ltp, quote, full), as the recorded Zerodha transcripts carry it; this web adapter puts its subscription mode number there.

Firstock's i_last_trade_time is in epoch seconds and the web sends it unchanged as ltt; feed timestamps are epoch milliseconds (docs/prompt/websockets-format.md). The desktop sends the trade time in ms.

The web's Quote sends oi 0 for an equity whose tick carries no open interest (data.get("i_open_interest", 0)); a value the broker did not send is left out, never sent as 0 (docs/api/websocket-streaming/quote.md, web openalgo#2376). The desktop's Quote leaves it out.
The web sends Firstock's circuit limits (i_upper_circuit_limit, i_lower_circuit_limit, /100); the desktop's common carrier drops them.
